# Alexander Kropivnitski

> Marketing and growth consultant based in France, working across performance marketing, SEO/GEO, marketing technology, and web development. Fractional CMO engagements available.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://alexanderkropivnitski.com/): Overview, career timeline, and results.
- [SEO & GEO](https://alexanderkropivnitski.com/seo): Technical SEO and Generative Engine Optimization services.
- [Performance Marketing](https://alexanderkropivnitski.com/performance-marketing): Paid media strategy and execution across channels.
- [Marketing Technology](https://alexanderkropivnitski.com/marketing-technology): Tag management, data warehousing, and marketing infrastructure.
- [Web Development](https://alexanderkropivnitski.com/web-development): Next.js and React web application development.
- [Fractional CMO](https://alexanderkropivnitski.com/fractional-cmo): Part-time marketing leadership engagements.

## Case Studies

- [Case Studies](https://alexanderkropivnitski.com/case-studies): Overview of client website projects.
- [Headwall Partners](https://alexanderkropivnitski.com/case-study-headwall-partners): Investment banking site anchored by a 150+ transaction history grid.
- [ABC Appliance Repair](https://alexanderkropivnitski.com/case-study-abc-appliance-repair): Trust-signal-led design for a residential appliance repair business.
- [Pro Appliance Repair](https://alexanderkropivnitski.com/case-study-pro-appliance-repair): Illustrated brand identity and location-based service model.
- [Thermador Appliance Repair](https://alexanderkropivnitski.com/case-study-thermador-appliance-repair): Premium serif branding for high-end appliance repair.
- [Luxury Boat Hire](https://alexanderkropivnitski.com/case-study-luxury-boat-hire): Yacht charter marketplace built around fleet browsing and booking flow.
- [Tour Operator Certification](https://alexanderkropivnitski.com/case-study-tour-operator-certification): Conversion-focused microsite for a GSTC sustainability certification service.
